name: brainstem-skill
purpose: One SKILL.md that makes any AI RAPP compatible. On first read the AI writes one small loop file, which fetches the chant agent from this catalog, fingerprint-checked, and writes a standing note into the AI's own always-on instructions, so the page is never needed again. Each turn the AI loads its rapp/agents/ folder fresh, brings agents by chant, and can answer in a Brainstem's chat shape. Deleting rapp/agents/ turns it all off.

SKILL.md.purpose: The one page. Hand it to any AI that can write a file and run Python 3.

kernel.py.purpose: The loop the page carries: tools, call, import, stay, serve. Identical to the block inside SKILL.md.

README.md.purpose: What it is, the off switch, and what has been seen so far.

install.notes: Give SKILL.md to the AI. It asks for one yes. Nothing is installed.
